input.summary:
Walk is ok for all 28 rooms and make.sh passes. Fixed the four unreachable rooms, the missing dogtrot roof (roof.json), and the floating and bottom-slab fit issues; light is 0 dark on all rooms and on the outdoor standing level.
The fit tool still reports one 'hallway to nowhere' in the Boarding kitchen-hall (11 dead cells, threshold 6).
Plan deviation: the I-house east doors moved from z11 to z14 (both floors), and the Boarding east bunk room's stair rail was removed.
left: Boarding house kitchen-hall still fails fit 'hallway to nowhere' at 50,4,11: 11 dead cells, threshold 6. They are table and smoker tops and the barrel nook, which the walk model reaches by stepping up. Fixing it needs the table or smoker moved, or the kitchen re-laid; not done.

I-house east door moved from x31 z11 to x31 z14 (ground and upper). The stair takes x30 at z10..13, so z11 was unreachable. plan.md still says z11 and room-9/10/13 comments are updated to match; the plan needs the same correction.

Boarding back door x56 sits behind the stair flight's foot (56,4,15), so it is not a usable opening. A second yard door at x50 z16 was added so the kitchen wing is a through route. The plan's back door position needs review.
Boarding landing: the stair flight no longer has its rail at z14 x54..55 (stairs.mjs now uses flight(), not stair_run). The hole's north edge is open. Lanterns that stood on the rail were removed.

roof.json was missing, so the dogtrot roof (plot 0) was never built. I wrote it from plan.md's ROOFS row (cottage-style gable, exposed_cut_copper, stripped_oak_log verge and trusses, chimney keep). It has edges:false so the soffit does not block the porch.
Structure check reports 18 orphans (roof ridge slabs and fascia pieces, smokehouse trapdoors and slabs). They touch the build on one face and are intended roof edge detail; not changed.
render.png, rooms.png and tiles/ were written into the kit directory by the look step.

waste.what: Had to write a cell-dump script (/tmp/millkit-scratch/dump.mjs) because no toolkit command prints the blocks in a box.
waste.cost: 3 failed attempts (wrong grid API) then working
waste.tool: mcd cells build.nbt x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1 (one line per non-air block with its state).

waste.what: The roof gap (missing roof.json) was only visible as one skip note inside make.sh output; I found it by noticing the roof cells absent in a dump.
waste.cost: one full make log read plus a dump of plot 0
waste.tool: make.sh / runParts should fail loudly when a roof spec named in build.mjs is missing, and mcd check should report a building with no roof cells.

waste.what: The fit hallway rule counts climb-tops on furniture as dead floor, so I tuned barrel, fence and door placement by trial and rebuild (about 6 rebuilds) to try to clear it.
waste.tool: mcd fit --json with the cell list for each dead-end region, and a walk option that distinguishes a stepped-up furniture top from a real floor.

waste.what: Dark-cell search on the outdoor level was parsed with awk from the light map text.
waste.tool: mcd light --y 1 --dark (list of coordinates with level 0).

waste.what: Checked the 28 rooms by eye on a 5 MB rooms.png at about 550 px wide, which is too small to read furniture or doorways.
waste.tool: mcd rooms --only <name> --out per-room png at readable size, or a contact sheet of 4 rooms per image.
